title: Wolf and Thorn Revisited
author: Felix Ishikawa
blurb: Bram Okafor, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
